$note: 父母宮（2026-10-12）：廉貞.父母。《深造講義》下篇 宮垣論 父母宮 p.575–595。父母存亡、刑剋、孝服、灾病、偏房繼室所生、父有外遇、重拜父母一類斷語不用；天巫、天刑、天壽、白虎丧门等引擎冇嘅星不用；要分日夜生、廟陷嘅條文暫不用。原書父母宮兼論上司，呢部份照用。

rules.text: 廉貞與七殺同宮，你和父母的緣分較淡，往往各有各的生活，聚少離多。
rules.en: Lian Zhen shares the palace with Qi Sha: the bond with your parents is lighter, and you tend to lead separate lives and see each other little.

rules.text: 廉貞與破軍同宮，你和父母的緣分較淡，往往各有各的生活，聚少離多。
rules.en: Lian Zhen shares the palace with Po Jun: the bond with your parents is lighter, and you tend to lead separate lives and see each other little.

rules.text: 廉貞與貪狼同宮，你和父母的緣分較淡，往往各有各的生活，聚少離多。
rules.en: Lian Zhen shares the palace with Tan Lang: the bond with your parents is lighter, and you tend to lead separate lives and see each other little.

rules.text: 廉貞化祿，你和父母一般感情融洽，相處和睦。
rules.en: Lian Zhen in Abundance: you generally get on warmly with your parents.

rules.text: 廉貞化忌，你與父母的感情較難融洽。
rules.en: Lian Zhen in Hindrance: warmth with your parents does not come easily.
